SELECT LATRD.LATRD_ID loincAtrDomainMapId, ACTRD.ATR_DOMAIN_CD domainCode,ACTRD.VALUE_TYPE typeOfResult, ACTRD.STRING_VALUE acceptedValue, ACTRD.RANGE_LOWER_BOUND rangeLowerBound, ACTRD.RANGE_UPPER_BOUND rangeUpperBound, LATRD.FLAG_ACTIVE flagActive, ACTRD.LAST_UPDATED_BY lastUpdatedBy, ACTRD.LAST_UPDATED_DATE lastUpdatedDate,
trim(to_char(RESULTS_STD || '' || RESULT_INTERPRETATION)) standardResults from ACCPTD_TST_RESULT_DOMAIN ACTRD, LOINC_ACCPTD_TST_RESULT_DOMAIN LATRD, CODED_EHARS_STD_RESULTS ehars where ACTRD.ATR_DOMAIN_CD = LATRD.ATR_DOMAIN_CD and LATRD.RESULTS_STD_CD = ehars.RESULTS_STD_CD and
LATRD.LOINC_CD = #{loincCode} and ACTRD.FLAG_ACTIVE = 'Y' and LATRD.FLAG_ACTIVE = 'Y'
